podcast.body: The band released their version of this 1963 classic by Darlene Love in early November 2020. The song had previously been given a "punk rock afterlife" by Joey Ramone about two decades prior. "Back in early November, the offspring suddenly released their version of the 1963 classic by Darling Love, which was first given a punk rock after life by Joey Ramone about 20 years ago."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
